structure: Part 7 (Import reason and additional details) read repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend at main 4c2119da in full for two journey pages of the live-animals linear journey. (1) features/import-reason/: page.js (id and slug import-reason), evaluation.js (binds reasonForImport, purposeInInternalMarket, destinationCountry, portOfExit and exitDate to their obligations), controller.js (GET/POST, render, reference-data selects, recoverable save, redirect to the next target), validate.js (reveal map per reason, required and stale-answer rules, payload/answer mapping), template.njk (visually hidden legend, one radio per reason with a conditional reveal for internal market, transhipment, transit and temporary admission horses), copy/copy.en.js and copy/copy.cy.js (English and machine-draft Welsh), and import-reason.fit.spec.js (20 tests in three describe blocks: feature, reveals, reveal accessibility). (2) features/additional-details/: page.js, evaluation.js (binds containsUnweanedAnimals and animalsCertifiedFor), controller.js, validate.js (unweaned gate derived from commodity lines), template.njk (certified-for radios, unweaned yes/no radios behind the gate), copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js and additional-details.fit.spec.js (9 tests in four describe blocks: rendering, unweaned commodity gate, validation, persistence and accessibility). To claim option labels and the default validator message verbatim it also read the reference stubs the pages render from: src/server/app/services/import-reason-purpose/ (index.js, stub.js), src/server/app/services/certification-purposes/ (index.js, stub.js), the validatorDefaults block of src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js, oneOf in src/server/app/lib/validate/validators.js, and UNWEANED_ANIMAL_COMMODITIES in sets/live-animals/services/commodities/stub.js. Claims cover each page's route, back link, caption slot, heading, every field, option and hint, required or optional, every validation message verbatim, every conditional reveal, what is saved, where save leads and the save-failure path, the Welsh copy, and each fit test. Section caption text, task-list rows, flow order and obligation status belong to parts 1 and 2 and are only referenced here.
